facts.fact: Tanzania's Ministry of Health said 222 public facilities, district, regional referral, zonal, specialised and national hospitals, are connected to an integrated electronic medical records system.
The ministry said the system lets authorised workers retrieve a patient's earlier diagnoses, treatments and lab results across facilities through the Health Data Universal API.
The ministry said the integrated EMR system, introduced in October 2025, now connects 222 public facilities.

systems.system: Integrated electronic medical records system (Health Data Universal API)
